about: Invented. People and things said once, in the states they can be in after Sleep. Conversations in `conversations` are read by Sleep, `unread` are staged after it, `quiet` are saved links with no conversation. `stories` are the questions (own words, rewording, partial) and the words any answer must hold.

conversations.title: Hiking plan
turns: I want to plan a two-day hike in the Dolomites in June, maybe around the Tre Cime. Any advice on huts?
Book huts early; Rifugio Locatelli fills up months ahead. Two days works well with one night at a hut.
Good. Tomas will come too, he has done a lot of hiking, and we have two weeks of leave then.
Then book the hut as soon as dates are fixed.

conversations.title: Sourdough
turns: My sourdough starter is sluggish since I moved it to the cold kitchen. What can I do?
Feed it twice a day with warm water and keep it near the oven light overnight.
I'll try the oven light trick tonight.

conversations.title: Quarterly report
turns: I need to finish the quarterly report for the logistics team at Hartwell by Friday and the numbers on returns look odd.
Check whether returns are counted by order date or by receipt date; mixed dates are the usual cause.
They are mixed. I'll fix the query and rerun it.
Good, then compare to the previous quarter after the fix.

conversations.title: Guitar lessons
turns: Tomas started lessons with a Portuguese guitar teacher on Thursday evenings, and the guitar teacher plays fado in a bar on weekends.
That sounds like a lovely way to learn. What does Tomas want to play?
The Portuguese guitar teacher told Tomas to start with simple fado chords. The guitar teacher says it takes a year to get the feel for the ornamentation.
Is Tomas practicing at home?
Yes, every evening for twenty minutes, and the Portuguese guitar teacher gave him a worksheet of chord changes to work through.
That is a good routine. Does the guitar teacher teach in person?
In person, in a studio above a bakery. The Portuguese guitar teacher charges forty euros an hour.

conversations.title: Bike
turns: My bike chain keeps slipping. The neighbour with the green van repairs bicycles on Sundays, I might ask him.
That is a sensible idea, a worn chain or cassette is the usual cause.

conversations.title: Natación
turns: Mi hija empezó clases de natación en septiembre con la profesora de natación de la piscina municipal.
¡Qué bien! ¿Cómo le va?
La profesora de natación dice que mi hija ya flota de espalda. La profesora de natación es muy paciente con los niños.
¿Cuántas veces por semana van?
Los martes y los sábados. La profesora de natación quiere que practique las patadas en casa, en la bañera.
Es un buen consejo.
Sí, y la profesora de natación nos recomendó unas gafas pequeñas con goma suave.

conversations.title: Regal
turns: Der Tischler aus dem Nachbarort baut mir ein Regal aus Eiche für das Arbeitszimmer.
Eiche ist robust und sieht schön aus. Wann soll es fertig sein?

conversations.title: Fuite
turns: Le plombier de ma tante viendra mardi pour réparer la fuite sous l'évier.
Bonne idée, une fuite sous l'évier peut abîmer le meuble si on attend.

conversations.title: Label printer
turns: I bought a Brother QL-800 label printer for the garage shelves, it prints on rolls of 62 mm tape.
Nice choice. Are you using it with the desktop app?
Yes, the Brother QL-800 label printer works over USB. I labelled all the garage boxes with it on Saturday.
Does it cut the labels automatically?
The Brother QL-800 label printer cuts each label automatically. I like that the Brother QL-800 label printer needs no ink, only thermal tape.
Thermal tape fades in sunlight though, keep that in mind.
Right, so the Brother QL-800 label printer stays for indoor shelves only.

conversations.title: Dinner
turns: There is a tiny ramen place near Linden station that closes at nine, we might go there tomorrow.
Arrive early then, small places often stop taking orders before closing.

conversations.title: Lectura
turns: Estoy leyendo un libro sobre mareas que habla de la luna llena y las mareas vivas.
Las mareas vivas ocurren con luna nueva y luna llena, cuando el sol y la luna se alinean.

unread.title: Shoulder
turns: The physiotherapist who treated my shoulder said I should swim twice a week to keep it loose.
Swimming is gentle on the shoulder, freestyle and backstroke especially.

unread.title: Café
turns: Das kleine Café am Hafen hat sonntags Streuselkuchen, den will ich unbedingt probieren.
Streuselkuchen ist ein Klassiker, am besten noch warm.
